services.desc: Our high-performance fleet offers luxury and speed with 40-115 horsepower motors. We are the only marina to offer watersport packages for an extra layer of fun for your float! Water toys available to rent include tubes, skis, wakeboards, and kneeboards. Our new model luxury tritoons have an additional toon down the center of the watercraft delivering a super stable float. My family had a great time on the lake. Gina and Tony are wonderful! I cant thank you enough for the great memories my family made today. Boats are clean and very nice. Our marina offers seasonal boat slips, new model high-performance ski, tritoon, and pontoon rentals with tow packages to wakeboard, ski, or tube, and a private concrete boat ramp with plenty of parking.
